note: Checked 14 November 2026. All times are GMT. Black Friday dates come from Amazon UK and the Trafford Centre; Argos, John Lewis, Currys, AO, Very and the Arndale blocked fetching. Christmas Markets hours come from DesignMyNight because the council's page blocks fetching. Lowry details come from Creative Tourist because the Lowry's site wouldn't load. Still to confirm: Northern Lights nightly entry times, arena and theatre show times, and the bus diversion routes, which TfGM doesn't publish. Kick-offs can move for TV.

cards.headline: 19 NOV → 30 NOV
cards.title: Black Friday deals start this week
cards.body: Black Friday is on Friday 27 November, but the deals start this week. Amazon UK's Black Friday Week runs from Thursday 19 to Monday 30 November; you don't need Prime, though some deals are Prime-only. At the Trafford Centre, Boux Avenue has 20% off full-price items from Monday 16 November, and Lindt opens its offers to everyone from Friday 20 November.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with Monday 16 November marked for the first Trafford Centre store offers and Thursday 19 for the start of Amazon's Black Friday Week, with a bar running past the week to 30 November.

cards.title: Christmas Markets: 10 sites, open daily
cards.body: The Christmas Markets are open every day until Tuesday 22 December on 10 city-centre sites: Albert Square, Lincoln Square, King Street, St Ann's Square, Exchange Street, New Cathedral Street, Exchange Square, Corn Exchange, Cathedral Gardens and Market Street. Most open 10:00–21:00. Albert Square has the big wheel and a pop-up pub, and Cathedral Gardens the ice rink; both stay until 3 January.
mg_caption: North to south · not to scale
cards.mg_alt: Diagram of the 10 Christmas Market sites, from Cathedral Gardens with the ice rink in the north to Albert Square with the big wheel in the south.

cards.title: Northern Lights trail opens at Heaton Park
cards.body: The Northern Lights trail opens at Heaton Park on Thursday 19 November and runs to Thursday 31 December, with a new Christmas Time Machine theme. Entry is timed, with off-peak tickets from £15.25. Car parking costs £7.50 and must be booked ahead. By tram or 135, use Gate 13 opposite Heaton Park tram stop; after 20:00 the 135 doesn't stop there.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with Thursday 19 November marked as opening night and a bar running past the week to 31 December.

cards.title: Two more Christmas markets open this week
cards.body: The People's History Museum's Winter Makers Market has 30+ stalls on Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 November, 11:00–16:30, with free entry; most visitors donate £10. A £10 preview evening runs on Friday 20 November, 17:00–20:00. The Trafford Centre's Christmas Fair and Markets open on Friday and run to 3 January, alongside a Haribo grotto.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with Friday 20 November marked for the makers' market preview and the Trafford Centre fair opening, and Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 for the makers' market.

cards.title: Light festivals in Bolton, Rochdale, Wigan
cards.body: Three free light festivals run this week. Put Big Light On fills Bolton town centre 17:00–21:00 from Thursday 19 to Sunday 22 November. Ignite lights Rochdale's Memorial Gardens 17:00–20:00 from Friday 20 to Sunday 22, with the town's Christmas lights switched on around 17:30 on Sunday. Light Night Wigan runs Friday to Sunday, free in the town centre.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with Thursday 19 November marked for Bolton and Friday 20 to Sunday 22 for all three festivals, with Rochdale's lights switched on on Sunday.

cards.title: Nine arena shows this week
cards.body: Co-op Live has Myles Smith on Sunday 15 November, Enter Shikari on Thursday, Good Charlotte on Friday, Hits Radio Live on Saturday and Don Toliver on Sunday 22. The AO Arena has Gladiators on Sunday 15, beabadoobee on Tuesday, Shinedown on Friday and Fontaines D.C. on Saturday. Check start times with each venue.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with arena shows marked on Sunday 15, Tuesday 17, Thursday 19, Friday 20, Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 November, with both arenas busy on Sunday 15, Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: City host Fulham on Saturday lunchtime
cards.body: City host Fulham in the Premier League at the Etihad at 12:30 on Saturday 21 November, and Manchester Storm play Fife Flyers at the AO Arena on Thursday. United are away at Liverpool at 16:30 on Sunday. Alan Turing Way is still shut northbound by the Etihad, and TfGM expects delays. Kick-offs can move for TV.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with Thursday 19 November marked for Manchester Storm, Saturday 21 for City v Fulham at 12:30 and Sunday 22 for United away at 16:30, over a bar for the Alan Turing Way closure.

cards.title: Hallé and classics at the Bridgewater Hall
cards.body: The Hallé plays Stravinsky's The Firebird at 19:30 on Thursday 19 November, from £18.50, and Elvis: Viva Las Vegas at 19:30 on Saturday. Classical Spectacular follows at 15:00 on Sunday 22 November, with tickets from £30.25 to £51.25 including the booking fee. The hall is on Lower Mosley Street.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with Thursday 19 November marked 19:30 Firebird, Saturday 21 marked 19:30 Elvis and Sunday 22 marked 15:00 Classical Spectacular.

cards.title: Christmas Carol Goes Wrong and more on stage
cards.body: Christmas Carol Goes Wrong plays the Opera House from Tuesday 17 to Saturday 21 November, and CATS ends its run at the Palace Theatre on Saturday. At the Lowry, the National Theatre's Bacchae has public shows on Friday and Saturday for ages 15 and over, and the free Funny People exhibition opens on Saturday 21 November.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with a bar from Tuesday 17 to Saturday 21 November for Christmas Carol Goes Wrong, Friday 20 marked for Bacchae and Saturday 21 for the last CATS show.

cards.title: Johnny Campbell at Crumpsall Folk Club
cards.body: Sheffield singer Johnny Campbell headlines Crumpsall Folk Club at The Cleveland on Crumpsall Lane, opposite Crumpsall tram stop, on Thursday 19 November. Doors open at 19:30, floor spots start at 19:45 and the main act is on around 21:00. Entry is £5, £2 concessions or £10 solidarity, with proceeds to Rainbow Surprise.
cards.mg_alt: Dot-matrix readout of £5, the entry price, for Thursday 19 November with doors at 19:30.

cards.title: Weekend and night bus diversions
cards.body: Corporation Street is shut one way from 08:00 Saturday to 21:00 Sunday every weekend until 20 December, so into-town 135s and 41s miss the Victoria Rail Station and Printworks stops. Bury Old Road closes 20:00–06:00 nightly until 23 November, diverting the 135 and 97. Hospital roads at North Manchester General close at weekends until 29 November, diverting the 41, 52, 53, 94 and 151.
cards.where: Corp St · Bury Old Rd · NMGH
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with Sunday 15, Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 November marked for the Corporation Street and hospital weekend closures, over a bar for the nightly Bury Old Road closure.

cards.title: Deansgate station shuts on market evenings
cards.body: Deansgate rail station closes from 20:00 on Fridays and 18:00 on Saturdays until the Christmas Markets end on 22 December; use Piccadilly, Oxford Road or Victoria. From Sunday 22 November, Northern adds 14 Sunday trains between Bolton and Victoria and 10 each from Rochdale and from Wigan via Atherton. That Sunday, buses replace trains between Blackburn and Clitheroe.
cards.mg_alt: Week strip with Friday 20 November marked 20:00 and Saturday 21 marked 18:00 for the Deansgate station closures, and Sunday 22 marked for 34 extra Sunday trains.
